company.name: Caledonian Wellsite Field Services Ltd
company.description: Onshore and onshore-terminal oil, gas and energy field services contractor operating from a base at Altens Industrial Estate, Aberdeen, with satellite depots near Grimsby and the North West. Provides wellsite and well-pad support: wireline and slickline unit transport, chemical (methanol, scale inhibitor, biocide) delivery and bulk fluid haulage, vacuum tanker waste recovery, mobile generator and welfare-cabin logistics, and lone-worker field technician callout across remote onshore conventional and coal-bed methane pads and gas terminals. Holds a standard international operator (O) licence (OM1093447) for 22 on-highway HGVs, runs a fleet of ADR-compliant tankers under the Carriage of Dangerous Goods regulations, and operates a journey-management and lone-worker monitoring scheme combining Iridium satellite and cellular telematics. All drivers run on EU/GB smart tachographs under GB drivers' hours rules.

metadata.generatedNote: Sample dataset reflecting a typical operating week (2026-06-15 to 2026-07-01) for a UK onshore oil, gas and energy field-services contractor based in Aberdeen with East-coast and North-West satellite depots. Covers wireline/slickline intervention support, ADR chemical and bulk-fluid haulage, vacuum-tanker hazardous-waste recovery with EWC consignment notes, generator/welfare logistics and lone-worker callouts to remote well pads and gas terminals. Reflects journey management and lone-worker monitoring over Iridium satellite plus cellular, GB drivers' hours on EU/GB smart tachographs, ADR/CDG dangerous-goods carriage, well-pad geofence and engine-hours billing, sour-gas (H2S) controls and operator (O) licence undertakings. References DVSA (MOT/HGV testing, walkaround defect reporting), the Traffic Commissioner (O-licence), SEPA/Environment Agency waste-carrier and consignment-note rules, OPITO H2S and LOLER/ALLMI lifting requirements. All companies, registrations, sites, plant and individuals are fictional.

notes.author: Gareth Pryce
notes.body: Slickline run completed first pass; gauge ring set at 2,140 m. Pad power-pack running on standby between runs - engine hours being logged for billing under the standby clause. Customer supervisor signed PTW extension to 16:00.

notes.author: Sophie Bennett
notes.body: Sour-gas pad callout. Personal H2S monitor alarmed at 12 ppm near the wellhead grease point - withdrew to upwind muster point, alarm cleared after 4 minutes once the bleed valve was reseated. Logged with the wellsite supervisor. All 30-minute lone-worker check-ins completed over Iridium.

notes.author: Transport Manager
notes.body: Daily rest infringement flagged by tacho analysis (8h05m vs 9h). Driver stood down from ADR duties pending review; relief driver assigned to RTE-013. Counselling session booked and infringement letter issued per our O-licence undertakings.

notes.author: Workshop Foreman
notes.body: Periodic tank test failed - ultrasonic survey shows shell wall thinning below minimum on the rear barrel section. Vehicle taken out of service and parked in the de-fleet bay. Recommend disposal rather than repair given age and mileage.

notes.author: Iain MacLeod
notes.body: Recovered 28,000 L of CBM produced water from Risley. Pad surface uneven - tilt sensor warned at 8.4 deg during suction, repositioned onto matting before continuing. Consignment note PCBM-309 raised; weighbridge net 27.4 t at Grangemouth.

notes.author: Callum Fraser
notes.body: Methanol load of 16,000 L bottom-loaded and earth-bonded at Aberdeen. TREM card and instructions in writing checked. En route to Crathes A; spill kit and Tier-1 plan on board. H2S monitor required at delivery pad.

notes.author: Workshop Foreman
notes.body: Welfare unit transporter VOR for clutch replacement. Parts ETA 27 Jun. WO-0004 genset/welfare logistics covered by VEH-006 flatbed in the interim.

notes.author: Journey Management Controller
notes.body: Banchory exploration pad is satellite-only - no mobile signal. Driver briefed to use Iridium check-ins on a 30-minute schedule and to confirm geofence arrival by SOS-device location ping. Sour-gas pad: H2S monitor mandatory.

notes.author: Account Manager
notes.body: Immingham terminal requires gate induction and an escort vehicle for all tanker movements; 5 mph site limit and Zone 2 ATEX controls. Weighbridge tickets must accompany every waste collection.

notes.author: Rhys Davies
notes.body: Mixed oily sludge collected at depot under consignment note FES/4471/26 (EWC 13 05 07). Awaiting weighbridge slot at Grangemouth - booked for 13:00. Quarterly consignee returns to be filed by Forth Environmental.

notes.author: Gareth Pryce
notes.body: Power-pack hour meter approaching 7,500 h service interval. Mast LOLER thorough examination current. Winch rope changed Feb 2026; tension readings nominal during today's runs.

notes.author: Callum Fraser
notes.body: Approaching Crathes A geofence; will arm engine-hours billing and don H2S monitor before entering the pad. Awaiting wellsite supervisor to open PTW for the chemical delivery bund.

notes.author: Donald Sinclair
notes.body: Rig-move plant transport to Errol: three skids plus the 60 kVA genset. Escort required from the A90 turn-off to the pad on the unmade access track. ALLMI HIAB ticket and lashing plan checked.
